title: Remove Settings patch hint flat exports
summary: Removed the two transitional flat Settings patch validation hint aliases while preserving the helpers on mediaPipelineSettingsView.
reason: WebView flat export cleanup remains an active opportunistic workstream. The Settings patch validation hint helpers already have namespace access and no cross-module flat consumers, so their direct window aliases can be retired safely.
behavior_before: settingsView.js exposed settingsPatchLocalValidationHints and settingsPatchLocalValidationHintLines both through mediaPipelineSettingsView and as direct window.* compatibility aliases.
behavior_after: settingsPatchLocalValidationHints and settingsPatchLocalValidationHintLines remain available through mediaPipelineSettingsView, but no longer create direct window.* aliases. The global export inventory and WebView public contract baseline now report 470 flat exports.
tests_added: tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui.WebViewHandBrakeSettingsUiTests.test_settings_patch_validation_hints_are_namespace_only_exports asserts namespace access remains and direct flat aliases are absent.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted test failed before source edit because window.settingsPatchLocalValidationHints still existed.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet to restore the two Settings direct window.* aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline, godfile map, split candidates, global export inventory, summaries, and restore the flat export count from 470 to 472.
